Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ClientController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameEventListener
public class ClientController extends Object implements GameEventListener
Client-side controller that connects to the server, sends player actions, and forwards server updates to the UI handler.
